purpose: Efficient staged selection; all scores are development-only until a locked, fresh-map gate

stageA.name: population_screen
stageA.method: same-map seat swap, map-density stratification, opponent-adjusted score and paired uncertainty

stageB.name: common_reference_screen
stageB.dataset: development-only; maps excluded from sealed final set

stageC.name: finalist_hall_challenge
stageC.note: Main reference comparison is V1.1; exploiters receive their own separate matchup budgets

fitnessNotes: Use paired win/draw results with side swapping; two sides on one map are correlated
Separate performance against population, frozen V1.1, historical snapshots, and exploiters
Do not optimize across or peek at sealed final-test maps
Model growth, neuron width, or Elo estimates alone never authorize a promotion
Actual neural learning requires updated weights, not just strategy-parameter crossover
